The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM filtering parser for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) sign-in logs
properties.query:
let AuthEventNames = dynamic(['FederatedLoginRequest', 'InteractiveLogin', 'AuthenticationUser',
                              'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResonse', 'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResponse',
                              'SentSamlIdpSsoResonse', 'SentSamlIdpSsoResponse',
                              'FactorMfa', 'InitiateSSOAuthFactor', 'SuccessAuthentication']);
let parser = (
    starttime:                  datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime:                    datetime = datetime(null),
    username_has_any:           dynamic  = dynamic([]),
    targetappname_has_any:      dynamic  = dynamic([]),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:   dynamic  = dynamic([]),
    srchostname_has_any:        dynamic  = dynamic([]),
    eventtype_in:               dynamic  = dynamic([]),
    eventresultdetails_in:      dynamic  = dynamic([]),
    eventresult:                string   = '*',
    disabled:                   bool     = false,
    pack:                       bool     = false
) {
    OCI_LogsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    // -- Authentication events only
    | where data_eventName_s in (AuthEventNames)
    // -- Time filter
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime)   or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    // targetappname_has_any: not applicable for OCI auth events
    | where array_length(targetappname_has_any) == 0
    // srchostname_has_any: not applicable for OCI auth events
    | where array_length(srchostname_has_any) == 0
    // -- Parse response status from nested JSON
    | extend _data    = parse_json(data)
    | extend ResponseStatus = tostring(_data.response.status)
    // -- Normalise result
    | extend
        EventResult        = case(
            // SAML exchange events: OCI does not emit a standard HTTP 200 for these;
            // the act of logging the event implies the exchange succeeded.
            data_eventName_s in ('ReceiveSamlSpSsoResonse', 'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResponse',
                                 'SentSamlIdpSsoResonse', 'SentSamlIdpSsoResponse'), 'Success',
            // SuccessAuthentication is always a success acknowledgement by definition.
            data_eventName_s == 'SuccessAuthentication', 'Success',
            ResponseStatus == '200', 'Success',
            ResponseStatus in ('400', '401', '403', '404', '500'), 'Failure',
            'NA'),
        EventResultDetails = case(
            // InteractiveLogin / AuthenticationUser: 400 = credential check failed
            data_eventName_s in ('InteractiveLogin', 'AuthenticationUser')
                and ResponseStatus == '400', 'Incorrect password',
            '')
    | where (eventresult == '*' or EventResult =~ eventresult)
    | where (array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0
             or EventResultDetails has_any (eventresultdetails_in))
    // -- Logon method & event type
    | extend
        EventType   = 'Logon',
        LogonMethod = case(
            data_eventName_s in ('FederatedLoginRequest',
                                 'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResonse', 'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResponse',
                                 'SentSamlIdpSsoResonse', 'SentSamlIdpSsoResponse'), 'Other',             // SAML/federation -- no dedicated schema value
            data_eventName_s == 'InteractiveLogin',           'Username & Password',
            data_eventName_s == 'AuthenticationUser',         'Username & Password',
            data_eventName_s == 'FactorMfa',                  'Multi factor authentication',
            data_eventName_s == 'InitiateSSOAuthFactor',      'Multi factor authentication',
            data_eventName_s == 'SuccessAuthentication',      'Username & Password',
            '')
    | where (array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in~ (eventtype_in))
    // -- Target user
    // principalName is set for InteractiveLogin (the attempted username).
    // FederatedLoginRequest has no principalName until the SAML assertion is
    // processed; fall back to additionalDetails.actorName.
    // AuthenticationUser uses the IDCS internal 'idcssso' service account.
    | extend
        TargetUsername = coalesce(
            data_identity_principalName_s,
            tostring(_data.additionalDetails.actorName)),
        TargetUserId   = case(
            coalesce(data_identity_principalId_s, tostring(_data.additionalDetails.actorId)) == 'IDCS', '',
            coalesce(data_identity_principalId_s, tostring(_data.additionalDetails.actorId))),
        TargetUserIdType = 'Other'
    | extend
        TargetUsernameType = iff(TargetUsername contains '@', 'UPN', 'Simple')
    | where (array_length(username_has_any) == 0
             or TargetUsername has_any (username_has_any))
    // -- Source IP
    // FederatedLoginRequest may carry X-Forwarded-For (comma-separated).
    // Take the first (original client) IP.
    | extend SrcIpAddr = trim(' ', tostring(split(data_identity_ipAddress_s, ',')[0]))
    | where (array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
             or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
    | extend Src = SrcIpAddr
    // -- Acting app (caller on behalf of)
    | extend
        ActingAppId     = data_identity_callerId_s,
        ActingAppName   = data_identity_callerName_s
    // -- Session
    | extend
        TargetSessionId = tostring(_data.identity.consoleSessionId)
    // -- Source device
    // User-Agent is stored as a single-element JSON array by OCI.
    | extend
        HttpUserAgent = tostring(parse_json(data_request_headers_User_Agent_s)[0])
    // -- Additional fields (source-specific, no ASIM column equivalent)
    // Only populated when pack=true; defaults to dynamic({}) (empty dictionary).
    | extend AdditionalFields = iff(
        pack,
        bag_pack(
            'AuthType',          data_identity_authType_s,                    // auth mechanism: fed / natv / USER / instance / resource / service / none
            'RequestPath',       data_request_path_s,                         // auth endpoint path (e.g. /saml/sso, /idp/sso)
            'Referer',           data_request_headers_Referer_s,              // originating URL -- critical for tracing SAML-initiated logins
            'Origin',            data_request_headers_Origin_s,               // client app origin in federation flows
            'XForwardedFor',     data_request_headers_X_Forwarded_For_s,      // full proxy IP chain (SrcIpAddr holds only the first hop)
            'SrcPort',           data_request_headers_X_Real_Port_s,          // source port of the login attempt
            'OpcClientInfo',     data_request_headers_opc_client_info_s,      // OCI SDK / CLI version -- distinguishes automated from interactive logins
            'CompartmentName',   data_compartmentName_s,                      // human-readable compartment name
            'EventGroupingId',   data_eventGroupingId_s,                      // correlates FederatedLoginRequest / ReceiveSamlSpSsoResponse pairs
            'AvailabilityDomain', data_availabilityDomain_s,                  // AZ where the authentication was processed
            'TenantOcid',        data_identity_tenantId_s                    // OCI tenancy OCID the auth event occurred in
        ),
        dynamic({})
    )
    // -- Event metadata
    | extend
        EventCount          = int(1),
        EventStartTime      = TimeGenerated,
        EventEndTime        = TimeGenerated,
        EventSchema         = 'Authentication',
        EventSchemaVersion  = '1.0.0',
        EventVendor         = 'Oracle',
        EventProduct        = 'OCI',
        EventOriginalType   = data_eventName_s,
        EventOriginalUid    = coalesce(data_request_id_s, tostring(_data.request.id)),
        EventUid            = coalesce(data_request_id_s, tostring(_data.request.id)),
        EventSeverity       = iff(EventResult == 'Failure', 'Low', 'Informational'),
        Dvc                 = 'OCI'
    // mapping ASimMatchingUsername
    | extend
        temp_isMatchTargetUsername = TargetUsername has_any (username_has_any)
    | extend ASimMatchingUsername = case(
        array_length(username_has_any) == 0, "-",
        temp_isMatchTargetUsername, "TargetUsername",
        "No match"
    )
    // -- Project ASIM schema columns only
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventCount,
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventType,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventVendor,
        EventProduct,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventUid,
        EventResult,
        EventResultDetails,
        EventSeverity,
        LogonMethod,
        TargetUsername,
        TargetUsernameType,
        TargetUserId,
        TargetUserIdType,
        TargetSessionId,
        SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Src,
        HttpUserAgent,
        ActingAppId,
        ActingAppName,
        Dvc,
        AdditionalFields,
        Type,
        ASimMatchingUsername
};
parser(
    starttime                = starttime,
    endtime                  = endtime,
    username_has_any         = username_has_any,
    targetappname_has_any    = targetappname_has_any,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix = srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    srchostname_has_any      = srchostname_has_any,
    eventtype_in             = eventtype_in,
    eventresultdetails_in    = eventresultdetails_in,
    eventresult              = eventresult,
    disabled                 = disabled,
    pack                     = pack
)
